title: SlipX parameter provenance
description:
Where a set of numbers came from (NFR-08, SCH-06).

This file is required, and its label is printed by tooling rather than only documented, because the failure mode it prevents is specific and observed: a plausible-looking number enters a config file, nobody records that it was guessed, and six months later somebody is tuning a controller against it in good faith. No parameter set in SlipX has been validated against a real car; until an outside contributor supplies a fitted set with a validation report, the honest phrasing is 'physically structured and identifiable', not 'validated'.

label.description: How these numbers were obtained. provisional: derived from literature or plausibility, measured against nothing. identified: fitted from vehicle data by slipx_id, with residuals. measured: directly measured on a scale, a rig or a coastdown with instrumentation. The weakest applicable label is the correct one.

source.description: What the numbers came from: a vehicle, a paper, a manufacturer datasheet, or an honest statement that they were estimated.

method.description: How. For an identified set, the manoeuvres and the fitting procedure. For a provisional set, the reasoning.

date.description: ISO 8601 date the parameters were obtained, not the date the file was edited.

contributor.description: Who. Required for registry submission (SCH-06, P2).

vehicle.description: The physical car, where there was one: chassis, motor, ESC, servo, tyres, ballast.

residuals.description: Per-parameter fit residuals and confidence intervals (ID-03). Required for an identified set: an identified parameter without a residual is a provisional parameter with a better title.

validation_report.description: Path or URL to the replay validation report (ID-04): measured inputs through the fitted model, with divergence in yaw rate, lateral acceleration and speed.
